nodes.code:
assignee_ids = params.get("assignee_ids") or []
title = params.get("title") or ""
todo_id = params.get("todo_id") or ""
actor_user_id = params.get("actor_user_id") or ""
recipients = [uid for uid in assignee_ids if uid and uid != actor_user_id]
if recipients:
    api.notify.send(title=f"New comment on: {title}", body=f"A new comment was added to the WorkQ item \"{title}\". Check it out for the latest update.", user_ids=recipients)
